title: Recover an AGV by adding it back to the system using Aveva API Geek+ RMS commands
summary: Use the Geek+ RMS “recover AGV” command exposed via the Aveva API to add an AGV back to the system. The source states that “recover AGV” means “add an AGV back to the system,” and that these commands are available via the Aveva API.
when_to_use: When an AGV has been removed and you need to add it back to the system using the Geek+ RMS “recover AGV” command via the Aveva API.
not_for: Do not use this procedure as a substitute for physical safety actions (e.g., E-stop) when the source indicates a restart-related safety note applies.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the Aveva API Geek+ RMS command workflow (select “recover AGV,” provide the required AGV identifier, run the command, and verify success/error response).
safety_notes: If the recovery is tied to a restart, follow the source safety note to E-stop before restart.
access_or_tools_needed: Aveva API interface/page that includes the Geek+ RMS command set (must show “Recover AGV”).
AGV identifier required by the “recover AGV” command UI.

access_required: Access to the Aveva API interface/page that exposes the Geek+ RMS command set.
system_preconditions: The AGV identifier you will enter must be known (the source indicates the command operates on an AGV and requires an AGV identifier).

visual_references.description: Aveva API page showing incorporated Geek+ RMS commands including “Recover AGV” (and related commands like pause/resume).

steps.title: Open the Aveva API interface/page that exposes the Geek+ RMS command set
steps.purpose: Access the UI that contains the “recover AGV” command so you can run it via the Aveva API.
steps.instruction: Open the Aveva API interface/page that shows the Geek+ RMS command set and locate the command list that includes “Recover AGV.”
steps.expected_result: The Aveva API page is open and the command “Recover AGV” is visible in the command set.
steps.healthy_condition: The command “Recover AGV” is selectable on the Aveva API page (not missing/hidden).
steps.failure_condition: The Aveva API page does not show “Recover AGV,” or the page cannot be accessed/loaded.
